AssayDetails: Buffer washes will be collected using a sterile sampling rings. The ring will be placed in the sampling site and held firmly in place. Using a sterile plastic disposable pipette, 2 mL PBS + 0.1% TritonX100 will be poured into the sampling ring and gently agitated for one minute with a sterile rod (with rounded, smooth ends). The sampling fluid will be collected using a sterile disposable pipette and placed into a sterile tube. The sampling procedure will be repeated with another aliquot of buffer wash material.This aliquot will be added to the first following sampling. One sample will be collected from the appropriate site on the leg. The vials will be frozen (-20oC) post collection until analysis. Total time required for buffer sampling for each subject is estimated to be up to 15 minutes at each sampling visit/timepoint.DNA was extracted from samples by an external provider (Qiagen) and samples shipped to the CGR Liverpool for PCR amplification, 2 step PCR singlets, of the V1-V2 region and sequenced on an illumina platform.
objectives: The overall objective of this study is to investigate the skin properties of dry legs as compared to non-dry legs over a one-week period.
